silhouette.reason: Free-standing notice board on two posts with a capping rail: reads as a notice board; the outline is a generic rectangle.
fixes: a small gabled hood or bracketed cap over the board

proportions.reason: 0.2 x 3.3 x 2.8 m; 3.2 x 1.9 m face at ~0.8 m off the ground, cap heights per README; lettering scale reads right.
fixes: posts slightly heavier (0.12 m) for a 3.2 m board

materials.reason: Dark green painted board with faint streaks, cream painted letters and brass raised letters separate well; the posts and frame are flat dark brown with no grain.
fixes: wood grain on posts and frame (wood_painted)
brass letters with a polished highlight on the faces

detail.reason: Six faces twice (flat and raised), title, brass divider, labels; no fixings, bolts or a back panel structure.
fixes: cross battens on the board back

wear.reason: Faint vertical streaks on the green paint; no fading, no chipped letters, no damp at the post feet.
fixes: sun-faded top band and chipped edges on the frame

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 drops the whole left (flat) column and its labels, so half the board content vanishes at distance; title and the raised column stay.
fixes: keep the flat column at LOD2 at low segment count (text() segments) instead of dropping it

technical.reason: QA clean (pack): 38.5k / 27.8k / 4.1k tris; LOD1 is barely lighter than LOD0, so lettering triangles are not stepped down.
fixes: lower text() segments at LOD1 (half of LOD0)
